messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands  can we get a concise framing for how mission influences roadmap tradeoffs?
Kate (CEO): Short frame: mission = make production inference predictable + low friction. That guides priorities: remove variance (autoscale, fallbacks), lower unit cost (batching/caching), and lower integration friction (simple API/SDKs).
Priya: Can we put that into a PM checklist? e.g., for every feature: impact on predictability, cost, friction.
Kate (CEO): Yes. Quick checklist suggestion: 1) Does this reduce cost per useful token? 2) Does it improve tail latency/SLOs? 3) Does it reduce customer ops work? If yes to >=2, high priority.
Riley: Practical question: Hosted features often ship faster. How do we avoid shipping Hosted-first features that block Dedicated/Private later?
Jordan: From eng side: add compatibility gates earlier (config pinning, model variant abstraction). If Hosted-only launch is needed, we add migration hooks.
Kate (CEO): Policy: prefer designs that can work across environments. Exceptions allowed but must have a documented migration plan and owner.
Alex: Competitors: how do we succinctly explain difference vs "managed endpoints" and vs "self-hosted runtimes"? Sales needs a one-liner.
Priya: Proposed one-liner: "Redwood delivers production-grade inference controls and cost transparency so teams get predictable latency, lower unit cost, and smoother rollouts—without building ops from scratch."
Kate (CEO): I like that. Emphasize the operational primitives (canaries, autoscale, KV caching) and Optimize recommendations in follow-up GTM copy.
Riley: Legal on quantitative claims? Sales asked if we can say "customers see 2x cost reduction" in decks.
Kate (CEO): Stick to qualitative or vetted case studies. If you want a stat, run it through GTM ops + legal for approval.
infra-bot: Recording and slides uploaded https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1726504321 :memo:
Alex: Thanks all. I'll draft a short playbook blurb and put in #product-playbooks for review. :thumbsup:
Priya: Happy to review.
Jordan: I'll add migration notes for Dedicated/Private to the infra runbook.
Alex: End of thread."
